functions.tdGroundItemAvailable:

		return false
	endif
	if  not TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundCrafting then
		return tdGroundItemGroup(GetItemTypeId(itm)) == quality
	endif
	if  not tdIsLanePlayer(TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundCasterLane) then
		return false
	endif
	if  not tdItemIsEquipment(GetItemTypeId(itm)) then
		return false
	endif
	if tdItemQuality(GetItemTypeId(itm)) != quality then
		return false
	endif
	if tdGroundItemLane(GetItemX(itm), GetItemY(itm)) != TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundCasterLane then
		return false
	endif
	return tdGroundPointInUpgradeCircle(GetItemX(itm), GetItemY(itm), TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundCastPoint_x, TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundCastPoint_y)
endfunction

functions.swap:
function swap takes nothing returns nothing
	local boolean isEnabled = IsTriggerEnabled(DamageDetection_current)
	local integer i
	local integer temp
	call trigger_disable(DamageDetection_current)
	if DamageDetection_toDestroy != null then
		call trigger_destr(DamageDetection_toDestroy)
	endif
	set DamageDetection_toDestroy = DamageDetection_current
	set DamageDetection_current = CreateTrigger()
	if  not isEnabled then
		call trigger_disable(DamageDetection_current)
	endif
	call group_enumUnitsAll(Group_ENUM_GROUP, DamageDetection_filter)
	set i = 0
	set temp = DamageDetection_funcNext - 1
	loop
		exitwhen i > temp
		call trigger_addCondition(DamageDetection_current, DamageDetection_func[i])
		set i = i + 1
	endloop
endfunction

functions.tdGroundHandleUpgrade:
function tdGroundHandleUpgrade takes nothing returns boolean
	local unit farmer = GetTriggerUnit()
	local player caster
	local integer lane_2
	local real castPoint_x
	local real castPoint_y
	local real tuple_assignment
	local real tuple_assignment_1
	local real tuple_assignment_2
	local real tuple_assignment_3
	if farmer == null or GetUnitTypeId(farmer) != TDConfig_TD_FARMER_UNIT_ID or tdIsGameOver() then
		return false
	endif
	if TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundBusy then
		call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(farmer), 0., 0., 3.0, "地面物品正在整理或升级，请稍后再试。")
		return false
	endif
	set caster = GetOwningPlayer(farmer)
	set lane_2 = GetPlayerId(caster)
	if  not tdIsLanePlayer(lane_2) then
		return false
	endif
	set tuple_assignment = GetSpellTargetX()
	set tuple_assignment_1 = GetSpellTargetY()
	set castPoint_x = tuple_assignment
	set castPoint_y = tuple_assignment_1
	if tdGroundItemLane(castPoint_x, castPoint_y) != lane_2 then
		call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(caster, 0., 0., 3.0, "只能圈选本路的地面装备。")
		return false
	endif
	set tuple_assignment_2 = castPoint_x
	set tuple_assignment_3 = castPoint_y
	set TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundCastPoint_x = tuple_assignment_2
	set TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundCastPoint_y = tuple_assignment_3
	set TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundCaster = caster
	set TDGroundItemRuntime_tdGroundCasterLane = lane_2
	call tdGroundStart(true)
	return false
endfunction

functions.tdCraftModeForQualities:
function tdCraftModeForQualities takes integer quality1, integer quality2, integer quality3 returns integer
	if quality1 > 0 and quality1 == quality2 and quality2 == quality3 then
		return TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_THREE
	endif
	if quality1 > 0 and quality1 == quality2 then
		return TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_TWO
	endif
	if quality1 > 0 and quality1 == quality3 then
		return TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_TWO
	endif
	if quality2 > 0 and quality2 == quality3 then
		return TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_TWO
	endif
	return TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_NONE
endfunction
functions.tdCraftConsumesSlot:
function tdCraftConsumesSlot takes integer quality1, integer quality2, integer quality3, integer slot returns boolean
	local integer mode = tdCraftModeForQualities(quality1, quality2, quality3)
	if mode == TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_THREE then
		return slot >= 0 and slot <= 2
	endif
	if mode != TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_TWO then
		return false
	endif
	if quality1 == quality2 then
		return slot == 0 or slot == 1
	endif
	if quality1 == quality3 then
		return slot == 0 or slot == 2
	endif
	return slot == 1 or slot == 2
endfunction
functions.tdCraftSucceeds:
function tdCraftSucceeds takes integer mode, integer rollPercent returns boolean
	if mode == TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_THREE then
		return true
	endif
	if mode == TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_TWO then
		return rollPercent <= 65
	endif
	return false
endfunction

functions.tdFarmerCraftSourceQuality:
function tdFarmerCraftSourceQuality takes integer quality1, integer quality2, integer quality3 returns integer
	local integer mode = tdCraftModeForQualities(quality1, quality2, quality3)
	if mode == TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_THREE or quality1 == quality2 then
		return quality1
	endif
	if quality1 == quality3 then
		return quality1
	endif
	if quality2 == quality3 then
		return quality2
	endif
	return 0
endfunction
functions.tdHandleFarmerCraftCast:
function tdHandleFarmerCraftCast takes nothing returns boolean
	local unit farmer = GetTriggerUnit()
	local item item1
	local item item2
	local item item3
	local integer quality1
	local integer cond_result
	local integer quality2
	local integer cond_result_1
	local integer quality3
	local integer cond_result_2
	local integer mode
	local integer sourceQuality
	local integer resultQuality
	local integer resultItemId
	if farmer == null or GetUnitTypeId(farmer) != TDConfig_TD_FARMER_UNIT_ID then
		return false
	endif
	set item1 = unit_itemInSlot(farmer, tdCraftVisibleInventorySlot(0))
	set item2 = unit_itemInSlot(farmer, tdCraftVisibleInventorySlot(1))
	set item3 = unit_itemInSlot(farmer, tdCraftVisibleInventorySlot(2))
	if item1 != null and tdItemIsEquipment(item_getTypeId(item1)) then
		set cond_result = tdItemQuality(item_getTypeId(item1))
	else
		set cond_result = 0
	endif
	set quality1 = cond_result
	if item2 != null and tdItemIsEquipment(item_getTypeId(item2)) then
		set cond_result_1 = tdItemQuality(item_getTypeId(item2))
	else
		set cond_result_1 = 0
	endif
	set quality2 = cond_result_1
	if item3 != null and tdItemIsEquipment(item_getTypeId(item3)) then
		set cond_result_2 = tdItemQuality(item_getTypeId(item3))
	else
		set cond_result_2 = 0
	endif
	set quality3 = cond_result_2
	set mode = tdCraftModeForQualities(quality1, quality2, quality3)
	if mode == TDCraftingLogic_TD_CRAFT_MODE_NONE then
		call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(farmer), 0., 0., 3.0, "前 3 格没有可合成的同品质装备。")
		return false
	endif
	set sourceQuality = tdFarmerCraftSourceQuality(quality1, quality2, quality3)
	if sourceQuality >= TDItemData_TD_ITEM_QUALITY_PURPLE then
		call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(farmer), 0., 0., 3.0, "紫装已经是终点，不能继续合成。")
		return false
	endif
	if tdCraftConsumesSlot(quality1, quality2, quality3, 2) then
		call tdConsumeCraftItem(farmer, item3)
	endif
	if tdCraftConsumesSlot(quality1, quality2, quality3, 1) then
		call tdConsumeCraftItem(farmer, item2)
	endif
	if tdCraftConsumesSlot(quality1, quality2, quality3, 0) then
		call tdConsumeCraftItem(farmer, item1)
	endif
	if  not tdCraftSucceeds(mode, GetRandomInt(1, 100)) then
		call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(farmer), 0., 0., 4.0, "合成失败：" + tdItemQualityName(sourceQuality) + "材料已损毁。")
		return false
	endif
	set resultQuality = tdCraftResultQuality(sourceQuality)
	set resultItemId = tdRandomItemIdForQuality(resultQuality)
	call unit_addItemById(farmer, resultItemId)
	call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(farmer), 0., 0., 4.0, "合成成功：" + tdItemQualityName(sourceQuality) + " -> " + tdItemName(resultItemId))
	return false
endfunction

functions.config:

	call SetMapDescription("四路黑潮同时压向中央裂隙。选择你的塔系，守住最后的门户，在精英与首领压境前撑到终局。")
